qe: The statistical survey of Patna and Gaya districts in 1811-12, famous in the early records of Bihar, was conducted by which officer of the East India Company?
qh: 1811-12 में पटना तथा गया जिलों का सांख्यिकीय सर्वेक्षण, जो बिहार के आरंभिक अभिलेखों में प्रसिद्ध है, ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के किस अफसर ने किया?
e: Francis Buchanan ek doctor tatha vaigyanik soch wale afsar the, jinhone East India Company ke liye Bangal ke jilon ka bada statistical yaani aankdon wala survey kiya. Patna tatha Gaya jilon ka unka daurra 1811-12 me hua. Woh apne saath roz-namcha (journal) rakhte the tatha mitti, khanijein, fasalein, vyapar, aabadi tatha imaraton ki jaankari likhte jaate the. Baad me unhone apna naam badal kar Hamilton rakh liya, isliye woh Buchanan-Hamilton naam se bhi jaane jaate hain. Unke survey ke aankde aaj bhi itihaskar tatha bhoogol-shastri istemal karte hain, kyunki unse 19vein sadi ki shuruaat me Bihar ki krishi, khanij tatha vyapar ki sthiti samajh aati hai. William Tayler 1857 ke samay Patna ke Commissioner the, John Shore lagan-vyavastha se tatha Reginald Heber ek Bishop tatha yatri the. Exam point: Patna tatha Gaya jilon ka survey 1811-12 = Francis Buchanan (baad me Hamilton), East India Company ke liye; woh mitti, khanij, fasal, vyapar tatha aabadi ke aankde darj karte the.

qe: What was the main purpose of the district survey for which the East India Company issued detailed instructions to its survey officer in September 1807?
qh: सितंबर 1807 में ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी ने अपने सर्वेक्षण अफसर को जिस जिला-सर्वेक्षण के लिए विस्तृत निर्देश दिए, उसका मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
oe: To recruit soldiers for the Company's army
To count the number of temples and mosques
To prepare maps for railway lines
To collect reliable statistical information on land, produce and people
oh: कंपनी की सेना के लिए सैनिक भर्ती करना
मंदिरों तथा मस्जिदों की गिनती करना
रेलवे लाइनों के लिए नक्शे बनाना
भूमि, उत्पादन तथा जनसंख्या की भरोसेमंद सांख्यिकीय जानकारी जुटाना
e: East India Company ko apne rajya ke baare me sahi aankde chahiye the, taaki lagan (revenue), vyapar tatha prashasan ke faisle bharose se liye ja sakein; isi liye September 1807 me Calcutta se survey ke liye vistrit nirdesh jaari kiye gaye. Un nirdeshon me likha tha ki afsar mitti, jalvayu, nadi, fasal, utpadan, vyapar, bazaar, jaati-ganan, imarat tatha logon ke jeevan ki poori jaankari ekatra karein. Isi survey ke tahat Bihar ke kai jile ek-ek karke chune gaye, jaise Purnea (1809-10), Bhagalpur (1810-11), Patna tatha Gaya (1811-12) tatha Shahabad (1812-13). Survey ka kaam 1807 se 1815 tak chala tatha company ke kaamon ke liye yah ek bharosemand aankda-sangrah bana. Railway lines, murti-ganan tatha sena-bharti is survey ka uddeshya nahi thi. Exam point: September 1807 ke nirdesh = zameen, utpadan, vyapar tatha aabadi ke bharosemand aankde jutana; Bihar me survey ka kram - Purnea (1809-10), Bhagalpur (1810-11), Patna-Gaya (1811-12), Shahabad (1812-13); poora survey 1807 se 1815 tak chala.

qe: Among the Bihar districts surveyed in the early nineteenth century, which one was taken up first, in the season of 1809-10?
qh: 19वीं सदी के आरंभ में सर्वेक्षण किए गए बिहार के जिलों में सबसे पहले 1809-10 के मौसम में किस जिले का काम हुआ?
e: Bihar ke jilon ka vaigyanik-statistical survey ek kram me hua: sabse pehle Purnea jile ka kaam 1809-10 ke mausam me hua, uske baad Bhagalpur (1810-11), phir Patna tatha Gaya (1811-12) tatha ant me Shahabad (1812-13). Har jile ke liye tareeka yah tha ki sardiyon me afsar ghoom-phir kar jaankari jutate the, phir garami tatha barsaat ke mausam me kisi shahar me baith kar apni report taiyar karte the; isliye ek jile par lagbhag poora saal lag jata tha. Survey ke aise kram se pata chalta hai ki Purnea jaisa seemant tatha Kosi kshetra bhi company ke liye utna hi mahatvapurn tha jitna Patna ya Gaya, kyunki wahan bhi vyapar tatha Ganga-kinare ke bandargah the. Patna, Gaya tatha Shahabad is kram me baad me aate hain. Exam point: Bihar ka survey kram = Purnea (1809-10) sabse pehle, phir Bhagalpur (1810-11), Patna-Gaya (1811-12) tatha Shahabad (1812-13); har jile me sardiyon me daurra tatha baad me report taiyar hoti thi.

qe: In the hilly tracts visited during the early nineteenth-century survey of the Patna-Gaya area, mica mines were worked mainly by which method?
qh: पटना-गया क्षेत्र के 19वीं सदी के आरंभिक सर्वेक्षण में देखी गई पहाड़ी खानों में अभ्रक (mica) मुख्यतः किस विधि से निकाला जाता था?
oe: Vertical shafts, with ladders made of single bamboos
oh: खड़ी खदानें (shaft), जिनमें एक-एक बाँस की सीढ़ियाँ
e: Patna-Gaya kshetra ki pahadi patti me abhrak (mica) ki khanein kaafi purani thi tatha survey me yahan ki khanon ka varnan milta hai. Kaam karne ka tareeka bahut saral magar khatarnak tha: zameen me khadi khudai yaani shaft banai jaati thi tatha usme baans ki seedhiyan lagai jaati thi. Yah seedhiyan ek-ek baans (bamboo) ko kaat kar banai jaati thi, jisme uski daaliyan seedhiyan banane ka kaam karti thi; aisi seedhi banane me kharcha kam lagta tha. Mica ki khan ke aas-paas ka gaon kaafi garib tha tatha naye afsar ko dekh kar gaon ke log darr ke bhaag gaye the. Sabse badi samasya yah thi ki mica ke bade tukde yaani tables nikaalte waqt toot jaate the, isliye keemti mal ka nuksan hota tha tatha kaamgaron ki haalat kamzor hi rahi. Steam crane, dredging tatha gunpowder blasting us samay is kshetra me istemal nahi hote the. Exam point: Patna-Gaya kshetra ke survey me mica nikalne ka tarika = khadi khudai (shaft) tatha ek-ek baans ki seedhiyan; mica ke bade tukde yaani tables nikaalte waqt toot jaate the; naye afsar ko dekh kar gaon ke log bhaag gaye the.

qe: During the survey of the Patna-Gaya area, a trader of Akbarpur led the survey officer to the mine from which the people of the region used to procure rock crystal (phatik). That mine was near which village?
qh: पटना-गया क्षेत्र के सर्वेक्षण के दौरान अकबरपुर के एक व्यापारी ने सर्वेक्षण अफसर को उस खान तक पहुँचाया, जहाँ से क्षेत्र के लोग स्फटिक (phatik / rock crystal) लेते थे। वह खान किस गाँव के निकट थी?
e: Patna-Gaya kshetra me patthar tatha khanijon ki talaash purani rahi hai. Survey afsar Akbarpur pahunche, jo Kuri nadi ke baayen kinare par basa ek vyaparik gaon tha, jahan kai dukanein tatha vyapari the. Wahan ke ek vyapari ne bataya ki kshetra ke log rock crystal yaani phatik Buduya naam ke gaon ke nikat ek chhoti pahadi ki khan se lete hain tatha woh khud wahan ja chuka hai; usi vyapari ke saath chal kar afsar ne yah khan dekhi. Phatik ek saaf tatha chamakdar patthar hota hai, jise log ratna jaisa keemti maan kar puja tatha saja me istemal karte the. Aise vivaran se pata chalta hai ki us daur me pahadi kshetra ke log khanij nikaal kar aas-paas ke shahron ke vyapariyon ko bechte the tatha bahari logon ko yah jankari sirf sthanik vyapariyon ke zariye hi milti thi. Silao apne khaja ke liye, Sherghati apne sthan ke liye tatha Wazirganj mica ke liye jaane jaate hain, isliye yah vikalp is khan se mel nahi khate. Exam point: phatik (rock crystal) ka sthal = Buduya gaon, Akbarpur ke nikat; jankari Akbarpur ke ek vyapari ne di; Akbarpur Kuri nadi ke kinare basa vyaparik gaon tha tatha wahan ke log khanij vyapariyon ko bechte the.

qe: The black stone quarried from the Paterkati hill near Gaya in the early nineteenth century was chiefly used for making which items?
qh: 19वीं सदी के आरंभ में गया के निकट पत्थरकट्टी (Paterkati) पहाड़ी से निकाले गए काले पत्थर का मुख्य उपयोग किन वस्तुओं को बनाने में होता था?
e: Gaya ke nikat Paterkati, jise aaj Pattharkatti kaha jaata hai, us pahadi par kale potstone yaani kathor kale patthar ki khan thi. Is patthar ki khaas baat yah thi ki woh bahut kathor tatha bareek-dane wala tha, isliye usse mukhya roop se musal (pestle) tatha okhli (mortar) yaani kutne-pisne ke auzaar banaye jaate the. Usi kshetra me ek aur khan thi, jahan se nikalne wala patthar Gaya ke Vishnupad mandir ke nirman me kaam aaya; yah bataya jaata hai ki us kaam ke liye kaarigaron ko Jaynagar se bulaya gaya tha. Aise sthal dikhate hain ki 19vein sadi me bhi patthar ki khan tatha patthar tarashne ka kaam Gaya kshetra ka bada rozgaar tha, jiski parampara aaj Pattharkatti shilp ke roop me chalti hai. Sikke, kaanch ki chudiyan tatha loha banane ke liye anya dhatu tatha saamagri kaam aati thi. Is khan ki ek parampara bhi prachalit thi: kaha jaata tha ki sabse pehle yahan kaam Harchand Rajah ne shuru kiya, jinhone Rohtas ka kila tatha Barabar ki gufayen banwai thi; patthar bahut kathor milne par unhone yahan kaam chhod kar apne kaamgar dakshin bharat me Ellora bhej diye. Exam point: Paterkati yaani Pattharkatti pahadi (Gaya) ka kala potstone musal tatha okhli banane ke liye istemal hota tha; usi kshetra ka patthar Vishnupad mandir ke nirman me bhi kaam aaya tatha kaarigar Jaynagar se bulaye gaye; yah parampara aaj Pattharkatti shilp ke roop me chalti hai.

qe: Lime for the famous bridge at Fatuha was got from a hill near Gaya, as recorded in the survey of 1811-12. Which lime-bearing material was burnt for this purpose?
qh: प्रसिद्ध फतुहा पुल के लिए चूना गया के निकट की एक पहाड़ी से लिया गया था, जैसा 1811-12 के सर्वेक्षण में दर्ज हुआ। इसके लिए किस चूना-युक्त सामग्री को जलाया जाता था?
e: Survey ke aankdon me Gaya kshetra ki pahadiyon me chune wala safed padarth milta tha, jise calcareous marl kaha jaata hai. Ise jalane par achha chuna (lime) banta tha tatha yah chuna imaraton me jodne tatha plastar (plaster) banane ke kaam aata tha; yahan ke log is safed marl ko 'Chunapatar' kehte the. Isi chune ka ek bada upyog Fatuha ke pul ya bridge ke nirman me hua. Usi kshetra ki khanon me granite, marl, jasper tatha abhrak (mica) jaise kai khanij ek saath milte the, isliye Gaya ka yah ilaaka khanijon tatha patthar ke liye jaana jaata tha. Kale basalt, lal balua patthar tatha hornblende alag saamagri hain tatha inka is chune se seedha sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: Fatuha ke pul ke liye chuna Gaya ke nikat ki pahadi se liye gaye calcareous marl se banaya gaya; us kshetra me granite, marl, jasper tatha mica jaise khanij bhi milte the, isliye yah ilaaka khanijon ke liye jaana jaata tha.
